mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% in a month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to increased borrowing costs and reduced corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the tightening signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong economic demand, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of periods with sustained HOUST increase.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3% in a month signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage costs and reduces corporate profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the tightening labor market signal.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals increased economic activity, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of triggered instances despite the increased economic activity signal.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) grow faster than GDP (GDPC1) over a 3-month period, it signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS growth > GDPC1 growth over 3 months
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of periods with RSAFS outpacing GDPC1.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 in a month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2%, it signals a strong labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increase > 200k & UNRATE decrease > 0.2% in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of triggered instances despite the strong labor market signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) by more than 2% signals inflationary pressures, which erodes real earnings and increases the cost of capital, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of periods with sustained CPI increase.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in GDP (GDPC1) is negative and housing starts (HOUST) decline by more than 5% in a month, it signals a weakening economy, which reduces corporate earnings and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: YOY GDPC1 < 0 & HOUST decrease > 5% in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the weakening economy signal.
